ledger_events_previous_hash_valid.name: ledger_events_previous_hash_valid
ledger_events_previous_hash_valid.value: "ledger_events"."previous_hash" IS NULL OR (length("ledger_events"."previous_hash") = 64 AND "ledger_events"."previous_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

transactions_transfer_distinct.name: transactions_transfer_distinct
transactions_transfer_distinct.value: transfer_account_id IS NULL OR transfer_account_id <> account_id

transactions_direction_shape.name: transactions_direction_shape
transactions_direction_shape.value: "transactions"."direction" = 'legacy' OR ("transactions"."direction" = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."transfer_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL) OR ("transactions"."direction" IN ('inflow', 'outflow') AND "transactions"."transfer_account_id" IS NULL)

budgets_goal_valid.name: budgets_goal_valid
budgets_goal_valid.value:
(
        "budgets"."goal_name" IS NULL AND "budgets"."goal_amount_cents" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "budgets"."goal_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND "budgets"."goal_amount_cents" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim("budgets"."goal_name")) > 0
        AND typeof("budgets"."goal_amount_cents") = 'integer'
        AND "budgets"."goal_amount_cents" > 0
        AND "budgets"."period" = 'monthly'
        AND "budgets"."rollover" = 1
      )
